U_0x006015.en: SThe wrecked <Chokijin> RyuOhKi, rebuilt as a humanoid mobile weapon with Grungust-series spare parts; it can never regain its old form. It keeps RyuOhKi's strengths in air and spell combat, and its extending Nyoi Kinkobo staff covers melee.

U_0x0061E7.en:
One of the "Four Gods" <Chokijin> like RyuKoOh and KoRyuOh - semi-living weapons the ancients built to fight the demons called the "Hyakuja." It forms when JakuOhKi, the Suzaku <Chokijin>, combines with BuOhKi, the Genbu <Chokijin>.
Its slender Black Serpent Sword and Burinkou shield suit close-to-mid range. The sword, a chain of Jatorin segments, flexes, stretches, and even becomes BuJakuOh's Black Serpent Mortar - a feat of the Sofu, the talismans forming the Four Gods, which allow their miraculous transformations and combinations.
JakuBuOh is fierce and proud - female, in human terms. Scarred in past wars, its form has changed often; Xia Nan and Tai Bei restored it near its true shape, adding Sofu parts based on a special humanoid weapon.

U_0x00674D.en:
One of the "Four Gods" <Chokijin> like RyuKoOh and KoRyuOh - semi-living weapons the ancients built to fight the demons called the "Hyakuja." It forms when JakuOhKi, the Suzaku <Chokijin>, combines with BuOhKi, the Genbu <Chokijin>.
The huge shell on its back and its Shinju Shield barrier give it the Four Gods' highest defense, and the self-repair of its Sofu - the talismans forming a <Chokijin>'s body - far outstrips the others. It also bears Sofu parts based on a special humanoid weapon, including modern missile launchers. Its main arm, the Black Serpent Mortar formed from JakuBuOh's sword, suits it to bombardment; it can further become the Genten Shoutenhou for ultra-long-range fire. In return its mobility is low and melee is a weak point. BuJakuOh is calm, quiet, and patient.

U_0x006CB2.en: A Four Gods <Chokijin> modeled on Genbu. Defense is high but mobility low; its true role is shielding other units, and it fights poorly in this form.

U_0x014A35.en: A humanoid mobile weapon for ground and artillery combat, also called the Type 30. Slow but thickly armored, it is a stable, reliable machine that can also hover, giving it excellent rough-terrain mobility. The Randgrith Raven is a modified Randgrith with a booster pod carrying a <Tesla Drive>, and its two linear cannons give it improved firepower.

U_0x014C8A.en:
A machine built by the Holy Kingdom of Langran in the subterranean world of <La Gias>. Blessed by the wind spirit Cyfis, it is known as the "<Masoukishin> of the Wind." Its Fulcanelli perpetual engine requires the operator's (pilot's) <Prana> for peak efficiency; <Prana> is essentially "ki" or "aura," so output depends greatly on the operator's aptitude.
The airtight frame allows action underwater and in space, and a self-circulation system protects the operator's body on long sorties. Aether - massless energy at rest in absolute coordinates - serves as its magical propulsion medium. The Orichalconium armor, sealed at particle level with numerological ward patterns, grants high magical defense.
Its Laplace Demon-type computer calculates causality to predict events, though this hinges on the operator's own magic. "Cybuster" is a guardian name against magical attack, not its true name.

U_0x0156CD.en: VThe Valsione, second Valsion-series unit, enhanced with <La Gias> alchemy. The ABMD system drives its frame and the DML system traces the pilot's motions, giving it flexible, human-like movement no other humanoid weapon can match.

U_0x0158A0.en: SShu's anti-alien combat <Armored Module>. It runs on an antimatter engine, with armor of ultra-tensile titanium reinforced at the particle level. Built for firepower and defense over mobility, its attack power is immense; co-designer Eric Wong said that with a pilot of superhuman ability it could crush the world's forces in a day. Shu's Kabbalah program reportedly lets it use astral energy. It hides many black boxes, but since Shu went independent after the <DC War> began, its sealed secrets remain a mystery.
